1.query:
fetch logs //, scanLimitGBytes: 500, samplingRatio: 1000
| filter outsystems.log.type == "Error"
| filter in(outsystems.app.name, $Application) 
| filter in(deployment.environment, $Environment) 
| filter in(outsystems.tenant.id, $Tenant)
| filter exception.message <> ""
| summarize Count = countDistinct(outsystems.log.uid) ,by:{Application=outsystems.app.name, Tenant=outsystems.tenant.id, Environment=deployment.environment, Pattern=exception.message}
| sort Count desc
| fieldsAdd link = concat("https://TENANTID.apps.dynatrace.com/ui/apps/dynatrace.dashboards/dashboard/DASHBOARD-ID-2.1#vfilter_Environment=",encodeUrl(Environment),"&vfilter_Application=",encodeUrl(Application),"&vfilter_Error_Message=",encodeUrl(Pattern))
| limit 100

7.title: Average duration of slower requests
7.query:
fetch logs //, scanLimitGBytes: 500, samplingRatio: 1000
| filter outsystems.log.message.tag == "SLOWSQL"
| filter in(outsystems.app.name, $Application)
| filter in(deployment.environment, $Environment)
| summarize {
		count = count(), 
		maxDuration = takeMax(toLong(outsystems.request.duration)), 
		avg = avg(toLong(outsystems.request.duration))
	}, by:{
		application = outsystems.app.name, 
        tenant = outsystems.tenant.id,
		module = outsystems.module.name, 
		action = outsystems.log.message.object, 
        environment = deployment.environment 
	}
| fieldsAdd avgInSec = round(avg / 1000, decimals:2)
| fieldsAdd ApplicationAction = concat(application, " | ", action)
| fields ApplicationAction, count, avg, maxDuration
| fieldsAdd cpu = avg * count
// added the below summarize to aggregate the biz events to the selected timeframe (on the top right corner)
| summarize Count=sum(count), Average=avg(avg), MaxDuration=max(maxDuration), TotalTime=sum(avg * count), by:ApplicationAction
| sort TotalTime desc
| limit 10

8.title: Error % per application
8.query:
fetch bizevents //, scanLimitGBytes: 500, samplingRatio: 1000
| filter event.type == "outsystems.error.patterns"
| filter in(application, $Application) 
| filter in(environment, $Environment) 
| filter in(tenant_name, $Tenant)
| filter msg.pattern <> ""
| summarize Count = sum(count) ,by:{Application=application}
| sort Count desc
| limit 100
